competencies.text: Review all Term 1 competencies in preparation for the Term Exam.

days.title: Cumulative Review — Weeks 1–5
days.content:
🎯 Learning Target

By the end of today's lesson, you will be able to recall and apply all major physics concepts from Weeks 1–5: physics in daily life, motion, machines, hydraulics, and light.

📚 Term 1 Recap — Weeks 1 to 5

WeekTopicKey Idea
1Physics in Real LifePhysics improves household, health & safety, work, and leisure.
2Linear vs Angular Motiond = rθ, v = rω, a = rα. Points farther from the axis move faster.
3Efficient MachinesSix simple machines + compound machines. MA = F_out ÷ F_in.
4Hydraulics & EnergyPascal's Principle; F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂. kWh = energy consumed.
5Properties of LightReflection, refraction, EM spectrum, LEDs, lasers, fiber optics.

🔑 Physics Big Ideas (Weeks 1–5)

  • Motion: translational vs rotational; r connects linear and angular quantities.
  • Machines: multiply force or change direction — but never create energy.
  • Fluids: Pascal's Principle makes hydraulics possible (car brakes, jacks).
  • Light: wave nature; reflection, refraction, EM spectrum. Used in meds, comms, entertainment.

🧮 Must-Know Formulas

  • v = r × ω (linear velocity from angular velocity)
  • MA = F_out ÷ F_in (mechanical advantage)
  • P = F ÷ A (pressure)
  • F₁/A₁ = F₂/A₂ (hydraulic equation)
  • c = f × λ (speed of light = frequency × wavelength)

💡 Study Tips

  • Draw diagrams for machines and hydraulic systems.
  • Practice 3–5 numeric problems per formula.
  • Know one real-life example per concept.
  • Link physics topics to chemistry topics (e.g., batteries combine both).

📌 Quick Check

  • Name all six simple machines. (Lever, wheel & axle, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, screw)
  • If a wheel rotates at 3 rad/s with radius 0.5 m, what is v? (Answer: 1.5 m/s)
  • What does SONAR stand for? (Answer: SOund Navigation And Ranging)

days.title: Match Game — Term 1 Concepts
days.content:
🔗 Activity 1 — Match the Pairs

Match each Term 1 concept from across all weeks to its correct description or example. There are 8 pairs and unlimited retakes to reach 75%.

match.right: A car driving forward on a straight road
Measured in rad/s — how fast an object spins
Crowbar or wheelbarrow — uses a fulcrum to multiply force
Pressure applied to an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally
Straw appearing bent in a glass of water
Sound — particles vibrate parallel to wave direction
Heating liquids to kill harmful bacteria

days.title: Scenario Challenge — Full-Term Scenarios
days.content:
🎯 Activity 2 — Scenario Challenge

Read each scenario and choose the best reasoning. These integrate concepts from the full term. There are 5 scenarios. You have unlimited retakes to reach 75%.

scenario.text: 🚗 A mechanic uses a hydraulic lift to raise a car. The input piston has area 0.01 m², and the output piston has area 0.5 m². If the mechanic applies 200 N, what is the output force?
🎡 A Ferris wheel rotates once every 30 seconds. A rider at the outer edge (radius 10 m) and a rider near the center (radius 3 m) both complete a full circle in the same time. Which statement is TRUE?

choices.label: A) Both riders have the same angular velocity, but the outer rider has greater linear velocity.
B) Both riders have the same linear velocity.
C) The inner rider moves faster.

scenario.text: 🧴 Your household has a bottle of bleach and a bottle of ammonia cleaner. What must you NEVER do?

choices.label: A) Store them in the same cabinet
B) Mix them together — releases toxic chloramine gas
C) Use bleach on white clothes

scenario.text: 💡 Your barangay installs LED streetlights instead of traditional incandescent bulbs. What is the primary benefit?

choices.label: A) LEDs are cheaper but dimmer.
B) LEDs use far less energy per unit of light output, saving on electricity and lasting longer.

scenario.text: 🔊 A concert is held in an open field. Why do people far away still hear the music?

choices.label: A) Sound travels through solid ground faster than air.
B) Sound waves spread outward through the air, and amplifiers increase the amplitude so the sound carries farther.
C) Sound travels at the speed of light.
D) Sound can travel through vacuum.

days.title: Formative Check — Escape the Term 1 Review
days.content:
🔐 Formative Check — Escape the Term 1 Review

You have 3 lives and 6 keys to unlock. You need 75% (5 of 6) to pass. This is your final formative check before the Term Exam.

escape.text: Which formula relates linear velocity (v) to angular velocity (ω) and radius (r)?
Which of the following is a COMPOUND machine?

choices.label: B) A pair of scissors (two levers + two wedges)

escape.text: What is the pressure if a force of 100 N is applied over an area of 0.02 m²?
Which EM wave has the LONGEST wavelength?
Louis Pasteur's swan-neck flask experiment disproved which theory?
Which government agency in the Philippines approves cosmetics and personal care products before they can be sold?
